basic_details.short_information: The National Centre for Radio Astrophysics (NCRA), Pune - a centre of the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR), an autonomous institute under the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India - has released Recruitment Advertisement No. 2026/09, inviting applications for 22 posts across administrative, technical and trainee categories. qualification.details: Project Administrative Officer: Graduate from a recognized University/Institute with 60% aggregate marks, plus a Diploma/Degree/Certificate course in Management or Administration, plus proficiency in personal computers and applications. Experience: 5 years' service in Level 6 and/or with equivalent TME. Project Administrative Assistant: Graduate with 55% aggregate marks, plus proficiency in word processing/database/accounting procedures. Experience: 3 years in Accounts/Purchase/Stores/General Admin/Establishment in a large, reputed organization. Project Technical Assistant (Low Hardware): Full-Time Science Graduate (60% aggregate) in Electronics or an allied field, OR Full-Time Diploma in Engineering (60% aggregate) in Electronics or an allied field, plus knowledge of personal computers and applications. Experience: 1 year in hardware maintenance. Project Technical Assistant (OMC): Same qualification pattern as Low Hardware - Science Graduate or Diploma in Engineering (Electronics/allied, 60%) plus PC knowledge. Experience: 1 year in hardware maintenance. Project Technical Assistant (SRC): Science Graduate or Diploma in Engineering (Electrical/Electronics/Computers/Network or allied, 60%) plus PC knowledge. Experience: 1 year maintaining a large computer system. Essential skills: Computer Organization & Architecture, Networking fundamentals, working knowledge of UNIX/Linux, problem-solving, ability to program in Python or other languages, familiarity with hardware installation, and teamwork/communication skills. Desirable: virtualization/containerization (e.g., Docker), working knowledge of Git, TCP/IP fundamentals (DHCP, DNS), and storage technologies. Engineer Trainee (Servo): BE/B.Tech in Electronics & Communication/Electronics Engineering from a recognized Institute/University with minimum 60% marks. Desirable: 1 year of programming/design/development experience in embedded systems, digital electronics, control systems, microcontroller/microprocessor-based systems, Assembly/C/VHDL programming, or RTOS/Linux. Library Trainee: Graduate from a recognized university/institute, plus B.Lib.I.Sc or M.Lib.I.Sc from a recognized university/institute, with 0–2 years of experience in the relevant field. Administrative Trainee: Graduate from a recognized university, with knowledge of typing and use of personal computers and applications. Desired: fluency in spoken and written English. Tradesman Trainee (Electrical): National Trade Certificate (NTC) or National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) awarded by NCVT in Electrical/Electrician trade (60% aggregate), and must mandatorily hold an Electrical Wireman License. | Age relaxation is given as per applicable rules. Age is reckoned as on 31-08-2026, the last date for receipt of applications.

salary_details.details: Posts 1–5 (Project Administrative Officer, Project Administrative Assistant, and the three Project Technical Assistant posts) carry a fixed Total Monthly Emoluments (TME) as tenure-based SKA project positions. Posts 6–9 are trainee positions carrying a fixed monthly stipend rather than a regular salary.

Visit the official application link: https://tinyurl.com/ncrajob-2026 and complete the online application before the last date.

Applications received online or by post after the last date (31-08-2026) will not be considered.
For details such as the full advertisement, application format and experience requirements, visit https://tinyurl.com/ncrajob-2026.

content_sections.heading: NCRA Vacancy 2026 – Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: NCRA Recruitment 2026 covers 22 posts across 9 categories, spread over Pune and Khodad. Posts at Sr. No. 1–5 are under the SKA India project (3-year tenure); posts at Sr. No. 6–9 are trainee positions outside the SKA project (2-year tenure, non-absorption after training). Abbreviations: UR – Unreserved, OBC – Other Backward Classes, SC – Scheduled Caste, ST – Scheduled Tribe, PwBD – Persons with Benchmark Disability, EWS – Economically Weaker Section, TME – Total Monthly Emoluments. All HQ locations mentioned are current; all posts are transferable within NCRA campuses (Pune, Khodad and Ooty).

content_sections.heading: NCRA Recruitment 2026 Tenure and Project Terms
content_sections.text: Sr. No. 1–5 posts are under the SKA (Square Kilometre Array) India project and will remain under the SKA Project for a period of 3 years. Sr. No. 6–9 trainee posts are not covered under the SKA Project; their appointment/training tenure is for an initial 1 year, extendable by 1 more year (maximum 2 years), subject to satisfactory performance. There is no absorption into regular NCRA service after training. The HQ mentioned for each post is for the present; all posts are transferable within NCRA's campuses at Pune, Khodad and Ooty. Candidates may be required to work in shifts, beyond office hours, and on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays, as per the exigencies of the Centre.

faq.question: Q1. What is NCRA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the National Centre for Radio Astrophysics (NCRA), TIFR, Pune, under Advertisement No. 2026/09, for 22 posts across administrative, technical and trainee categories, including 5 posts under the SKA India project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NCRA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 22 vacancies are notified across 9 post categories: 2 Project Administrative Officer, 1 Project Administrative Assistant, 3 Project Technical Assistant (Low Hardware), 2 Project Technical Assistant (OMC), 3 Project Technical Assistant (SRC), 2 Engineer Trainee (Servo), 1 Library Trainee, 6 Administrative Trainee, and 2 Tradesman Trainee (Electrical).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NCRA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications, whether online or by post, is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for NCRA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post — ranging from a Graduate degree (55–60% aggregate) for administrative posts, Science Graduate/Diploma in Engineering for technical posts, BE/B.Tech for Engineer Trainee, B.Lib.I.Sc/M.Lib.I.Sc for Library Trainee, to NTC/NAC certification for Tradesman Trainee. Full post-wise qualification is listed in the Eligibility section above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NCRA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit ranges from 28 years to 40 years depending on the post and category, with age relaxation as per applicable rules, reckoned as on 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for NCRA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates are encouraged to apply online at https://tinyurl.com/ncrajob-2026. Those who cannot apply online may send a hard copy application in the prescribed format to the Administrative Officer-D (Establishment), NCRA-TIFR, Pune, before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NCRA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertisement does not describe the selection process in its own text; it refers candidates to a separate link on the NCRA website for the detailed selection procedure.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for NCRA Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Salary/stipend ranges from Rs.18,500/- per month (Tradesman Trainee) to Rs.1,03,400/- per month (Project Administrative Officer), depending on the post, as fixed Total Monthly Emoluments (TME).
